general.a1: Henzo is a platform for salons: your own booking link, one calendar, client base, and email reminders. Clients book via your link or on the site.
general.a2: Salon owner: click "Get 3 months free" on the business page, fill in the form, and set up your salon. Client: open your salon's booking link and choose a time.
general.q3: In which countries and languages is Henzo available?
general.a3: We currently operate in Vietnam and plan to expand to other countries over time. The interface is available in English, Russian and Vietnamese.

business.q1: How do I connect my salon?
business.a1: Register on the business page, confirm your email, then fill in your salon details: address, services, staff and schedule.
business.a2: Yes. 3 months free, then a monthly subscription (390,000 VND/month).
business.a3: Online booking 24/7, one calendar for all staff, client base with visit history, email reminders, your booking link and QR, revenue and reports.
business.a4: No. Payment is made at the salon.
business.q5: How do I cancel my subscription?
business.a5: You can cancel in your account subscription settings. Access continues until the end of the paid period.

account.q1: How do I create an account?
account.a1: For salon owners: use the business page and sign up with email or Google. For clients: use the salon's booking link or register on the site.
account.q2: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
account.a2: Click "Forgot password" on the login page, enter your email, and we'll send you a reset link.
account.q3: How do I update my information?
account.a3: Log in and go to Profile settings (for personal data) or Salon info (for business details).
